correctness.rationale: Enumeration verified: 26704 connected labeled graphs on 6 vertices and exactly 112 canonical types; artifact masks equal the independently recomputed permutation-min canonical masks. All 112 n=6 Betti tables and all 8 n=7-sample tables were recomputed from scratch by the auditor via an independent exact-QQ Hochster implementation and agree exactly. Matching invariants (im, maxmatch, mmm) recomputed by brute-force 2^m enumeration agree on all 112; pd/reg are consistent with the tables; reported distributions (reg 67x1/45x2, pd 44x5/64x4/4x3, 55 distinct tables, im<=reg<=mmm with 0 violations, reg==im 107/112, reg==mmm 54/112, 40 with reg=im=mmm=2) all re-derive from the artifacts. Witness G* (id 4, edges 02,04,05,12,13): induced matching {(0,4),(1,3)} verified induced and maximal, no single edge maximal (each misses another edge, checked), induced subcomplex on {0,1,3,4} is the 4-cycle with H1 dim 1 (auditor recomputation confirms the (W=[0,1,3,4],r=1) contributor to beta_{2,4}), giving reg>=2 over any field by totally-unimodular Hochster ranks, closed by the cited Ha-Van Tuyl reg<=mmm=2 bound. Deviation from the topic plan (Koszul-Tor in place of Schreyer-Buchberger) is honestly disclosed in DRAFT Limitations and computes Tor by definition, so it does not falsify any table; full tables are computational evidence over QQ (char 0) while only the witness lemma is a field-independent proof, a distinction the DRAFT preserves.

originality.rationale: Live substantive comparison: Hibi et al. 1412.3881 proves general im<=reg<=mmm bounds and studies dominating induced matchings but publishes no 6-vertex census; Jacques thesis math/0410107 gives Betti/pd only for cycles and forests (a small subfamily of the 112); Banerjee-Yogeshwaran studies asymptotic random-graph regularity, complementary to an exact small slice; Woodroofe concerns chordal/shellability obstructions, a different invariant; OEIS A001349 only fixes the scope count 112; Macaulay2 EdgeIdeals documents computability of single cases, not this uniform census. No source publishes the 112-table census with per-graph cross-checked logs or the G* reg=im=mmm=2 certificate; the tables are not mechanically implied by the general inequalities or forest/cycle formulas. Internal nearest hit SCOPE004 (ladder reg=ceil(n/2) formula) is a single-family result, materially narrower in scope and invariants.

value.rationale: Headline result is a rigorously established exact invariant set for a natural object class: full graded Betti tables plus pd/reg/im/mmm for the complete 6-vertex connected slice (112 isomorphism types, a natural parameter scope per OEIS), motivated before computation by the recognized Hochster-Froberg-Kalai-Meshulam-Ha-Van Tuyl matching-bounds calibration program, with a proved field-independent extremal witness G* attaining reg=im=mmm=2. Values were not known or mechanically implied; a future researcher can reasonably need the precise tables for conjecture and software testing. This satisfies the exact-invariant paragraph: motivated object and invariant, non-trivial value, retrievable datum. It is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration (distributions, sandwich verification, and witness give interpretation). The 7-vertex component is honestly described as an 8-graph sample, not a complete census, so it does not erase the independently valuable n=6 headline.

decisive_checks: Auditor recomputed 26704 connected labeled 6-vertex graphs and 112 permutation-min canonical types; artifact masks match exactly.
Auditor independently recomputed all 112 n=6 and all 8 n=7 Hochster Betti tables from scratch over QQ: 120/120 agree with artifacts.
Auditor recomputed im/maxmatch/mmm by brute-force 2^m enumeration on all 112: 0 mismatches; sandwich holds with 0 violations; counts 107 reg==im, 54 reg==mmm, 40 reg=im=mmm=2 re-derive.

Witness G* hand-verified: induced matching, maximality, no singleton maximal edge, C4 independence complex on {0,1,3,4} with H1 dim 1 giving beta_{2,4}>=1 and reg>=2, closed by reg<=mmm=2; first such id confirmed.
Prior abstracts retrieved and compared at theorem/claim level: only general bounds, forest/cycle formulas, or asymptotic results; no 112-table census or G* certificate found.
residual_risks: Full n=6 tables are certified only in characteristic 0 (QQ exact ranks); positive-characteristic Betti numbers could differ in principle outside the C4 witness class, which is itself characteristic-independent.

The 'resolution' cross-check is Koszul-Tor strand homology, not logged Schreyer-Buchberger differentials as originally planned; both routes share the independent-set combinatorics, so the dual-log independence is weaker than two fully disjoint engines, though the auditor's third implementation mitigates this.
The upper-bound step reg<=mmm relies on the cited published Ha-Van Tuyl theorem rather than a self-contained proof; a citation error there would affect the witness closure.
The 7-vertex sample is single-route (Hochster only) and pre-registration of the seed cannot be externally timestamp-verified.
